task.mcakingdoms.dynasty.court.title: Read the court and succession
task.mcakingdoms.dynasty.court.help: Shows a kingdom's law of succession, the legitimacy reading, the succession under way and why its heir, candidates and claims you may see, court titles and memorials. Read-only.
task.mcakingdoms.dynasty.law.title: Adopt a law of succession
task.mcakingdoms.dynasty.law.help: The leader or an operator chooses how the next vacancy of the leadership is decided. Manual only, the default, leaves it to the officials as before. Refused while a succession is under way.
task.mcakingdoms.dynasty.answer.title: Answer an offered crown
task.mcakingdoms.dynasty.answer.help: When the law names you heir, accept the crown to be seated as leader, or decline it. Declining renounces your place, and the next heir is considered.
task.mcakingdoms.dynasty.confirm.title: Confirm or object to an heir
task.mcakingdoms.dynasty.confirm.help: For the council (player officials and mandate holders) or an operator, when the law asks the council to confirm its heir. A majority of the council decides either way.
task.mcakingdoms.dynasty.review.title: Review a succession
task.mcakingdoms.dynasty.review.help: For an official with the Appoint officials responsibility, or an operator: ask the law again once missing evidence is available, or leave the succession to the officials.
task.mcakingdoms.dynasty.renounce.title: Renounce your place in a succession
task.mcakingdoms.dynasty.renounce.help: Leaves a kingdom's line of succession, if you are in it. Only the crown can restore your place, when you ask with a claim.
task.mcakingdoms.dynasty.claim.title: File a claim with the crown
task.mcakingdoms.dynasty.claim.help: Contest the order of succession, ask to be recognized as a member of the ruling house, or ask for a renounced place back. The crown decides; every decision is kept, and a dismissed claim may be filed again after a wait.
task.mcakingdoms.dynasty.withdraw.title: Withdraw your claim
task.mcakingdoms.dynasty.withdraw.help: Withdraws one of your open claims. Its record is kept.
task.mcakingdoms.dynasty.decide.title: Decide a claim
task.mcakingdoms.dynasty.decide.help: For an official with the Appoint officials responsibility, or an operator; never the claimant. An upheld claim changes the succession only from this decision on.
task.mcakingdoms.dynasty.grant_title.hel: For an official with the Award honors responsibility, or an operator. A court rank is ceremonial: it grants no authority, office or command. A player recipient accepts it first; landed ranks name one settlement of the kingdom.

task.mcakingdoms.dynasty.revoke_title.he: For the title's grantor, an official with the Award honors responsibility, or an operator. Its record is kept, and any charter of it reads as historical.

task.mcakingdoms.development.read.title: Read a settlement's development
task.mcakingdoms.development.read.help: Shows the server's development mode, the settlement's tier and what earned it, its recognized buildings, and every work there with what it still needs and why it waits. Read-only.
task.mcakingdoms.development.propose.hel: For an official with the Appoint officials responsibility, or an operator. Posts a work for a settlement; players fund it with real deliveries. In managed growth, a buildable work is surveyed where you stand: stand on its plot.
task.mcakingdoms.development.approve.hel: For an official with the Appoint officials responsibility, or an operator: opens a surveyed work to deliveries.
Inside the work's settlement, hand over what you carry that the work still needs. Only plain items are taken (nothing named, enchanted or marked), never more than it needs; if the record cannot be saved, they come back.
task.mcakingdoms.development.pause.title: Pause a public work
task.mcakingdoms.development.pause.help: For an official: stops a work at once, construction included. Resume it after review.
task.mcakingdoms.development.resume.help: For an official: continues a paused work. Construction checks the rest of its plot before it places anything.
task.mcakingdoms.development.cancel.help: For an official. Contributors claim their deliveries back with Claim development refunds, unless the materials are already built in. Built blocks stay.
task.mcakingdoms.development.repair.help: For an official, when a work is blocked or met a block someone changed: survey the rest of its plot again and continue, or remove what it built (only where unchanged) and cancel it.
task.mcakingdoms.development.opt_in.help: For an official, or an operator: in managed growth, lets funded works be built on their surveyed plots in this settlement. Off, its works are milestones only.
task.mcakingdoms.development.protect_hom: Keeps every construction away from the land around the bed you last slept in. Stand near your bed.
task.mcakingdoms.development.refunds.hel: Returns the deliveries you made to works that were cancelled before their materials were built in.

task.mcakingdoms.villages.here.title: Living Villages village here
task.mcakingdoms.villages.here.help: Who holds the village you stand in, its people, war and peace, in plain words. Read-only.
task.mcakingdoms.villages.settlement.hel: Its civic kingdom, the realm that holds it, the recognized government, its people and any war. Read-only.
task.mcakingdoms.villages.realm.title: View its realm
task.mcakingdoms.villages.realm.help: A realm's capital, villages you know, its military commander, its agreements, wars and recent history. Read-only.
task.mcakingdoms.villages.open.title: Open village
task.mcakingdoms.villages.open.help: Opens Living Villages' own village screen for the village you stand in or your faction.
task.mcakingdoms.villages.join.title: Join the army
task.mcakingdoms.villages.join.help: Joins the Living Villages village you stand near as a member of its army. You do not become its commander or ruler.
task.mcakingdoms.villages.growth.title: Why is growth paused?
task.mcakingdoms.villages.growth.help: What the village is waiting for (beds, money, ground, a siege) and what helps. Read-only.
task.mcakingdoms.villages.supply.title: Provide supplies
task.mcakingdoms.villages.supply.help: Hands over currency or smithing materials to the village you stand in. Only what its stores have room for is taken.
task.mcakingdoms.villages.quiet.title: Living Villages announcements
task.mcakingdoms.villages.quiet.help: Choose whether you hear about agreements and defeats of realms other than your own.
task.mcakingdoms.villages.quiet.field.qu: Only my realm and places I know
task.mcakingdoms.warfare.realm_peace.tit: War and peace with a realm
task.mcakingdoms.warfare.realm_peace.hel: Proposes peace, a ceasefire, an alliance or a cession between a party you speak for and a realm or kingdom. An AI realm answers at once by its own interests; a player-led party must sign.
task.mcakingdoms.warfare.realm_sign.titl: Sign an agreement with a realm
task.mcakingdoms.warfare.realm_sign.help: Signs a proposed agreement for the party you speak for; it takes effect at once.
task.mcakingdoms.warfare.realm_reject.ti: Reject an agreement with a realm
task.mcakingdoms.warfare.realm_reject.he: Refuses a proposed agreement; native relations are not changed.
task.mcakingdoms.warfare.realm_end.title: End an agreement with a realm
task.mcakingdoms.warfare.realm_end.help: Ends an agreement in force for the party you speak for. A truce it set still runs its course.
task.mcakingdoms.villages.status.title: Living Villages integration status
task.mcakingdoms.villages.status.help: Installed versions, each capability's state with its reason, the effective policies and the queues. Read-only.
task.mcakingdoms.villages.inspect.title: Inspect a Living Villages binding
task.mcakingdoms.villages.inspect.help: The village, realm, claim and provenance behind a settlement, and what blocks it. Read-only.
task.mcakingdoms.villages.conflicts.titl: Living Villages records waiting for an operator
task.mcakingdoms.villages.conflicts.help: Ambiguous or pending villages, wars that need recovery and interrupted operations. Read-only.
task.mcakingdoms.villages.preview.title: Preview the Living Villages import
task.mcakingdoms.villages.preview.help: What an import would bind, match, leave for a decision or keep realm-only. Changes nothing.
task.mcakingdoms.villages.bind.title: Bind an ambiguous village
task.mcakingdoms.villages.bind.help: Binds a waiting Living Villages village to the settlement you choose. The settlement keeps its name, kingdom and history.
task.mcakingdoms.villages.separate.title: Keep a village separate
task.mcakingdoms.villages.separate.help: Makes a waiting Living Villages village its own new settlement, leaving the nearby records as they are.
task.mcakingdoms.villages.associate.titl: Associate a realm with a kingdom government
task.mcakingdoms.villages.associate.help: Records that a kingdom's government speaks for a realm, for diplomacy or diplomacy and war. Never inferred from names or culture.
task.mcakingdoms.villages.dissociate.hel: Ends a kingdom government's association with a realm; agreements already signed stay.
task.mcakingdoms.villages.adopt.title: Enable Living Villages management here
task.mcakingdoms.villages.adopt.help: Places an existing settlement under Living Villages' simulation, counted from the people and beds already there. Nothing is built, flattened or replaced while construction in adopted villages is off.
task.mcakingdoms.villages.rename.title: Rename a Living Villages village
task.mcakingdoms.villages.rename.help: Renames it in MCA: Kingdoms and Living Villages together; its team, banner and records are unchanged.
task.mcakingdoms.villages.recover.title: Recover a Living Villages record
task.mcakingdoms.villages.recover.help: Resolves one interrupted operation or war record after checking Living Villages' current state. Nothing is replayed or paid twice.
